mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s take a moment to really feel what it means to carry your own soundtrack. If you’ve ever gotten lost in a song, or felt that spark in your chest when a favorite tune comes on, you already know—music isn’t just background noise. It’s how we remember, how we connect, how we heal, and sometimes, how we find hope again. Every mixtape, every playlist, every song that’s touched your life—those are chapters in your story. And you’re writing that story with every note and every memory. So, here’s what you can carry with you: Sharing music can say what words just can’t. Simple rituals—like putting together a mixtape—can ground you when life feels shaky. Grief and joy? They can show up together, each shaping the other in quiet ways. Letting people in, even if it’s tough, is part of healing. And those old songs you love? They’re proof the past never really leaves us—it echoes on. When you create new memories, you’re not erasing the old ones; you’re simply adding to your own rich story. Sometimes, when life feels like too much, music can help you make sense of it all. And remember—letting go isn’t a single moment. It’s a journey. The right song at the right time? It can change everything. Your soundtrack belongs to you. Whatever happens next, you get to shape it. So as you go forward, keep choosing music that lifts you up—maybe it’s an old favorite from childhood, or something brand new that sparks joy. Don’t hesitate to make your own mixtapes, or to share them, or to let music say what your heart is feeling. Life will bring its share of loss, uncertainty, and challenge. But it’s also full of beautiful moments, laughter, and hope. Trust that your soundtrack will carry you through. Because sometimes, the right song can make even the hardest days feel possible again.
